entries.name: Packet preflight
entries.semantic_contract: Reconcile repository and packet execution baseline without mutation or authority creation.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: A PASS does not grant packet or operator-reserved authority.

entries.name: Repository reconciliation
entries.semantic_contract: Resolve current repository state, branches, programme state and source precedence.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Reconciliation cannot rewrite programme state or infer missing authority.

entries.name: Authority resolution
entries.semantic_contract: Resolve existing recorded authority and reserved boundaries.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Capability can resolve authority but never grant it.

entries.name: Scope classification
entries.semantic_contract: Classify requested work as in-scope, out-of-scope or ambiguous under the governing plan.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Ambiguous scope must fail closed rather than expand automatically.

entries.name: Prerequisite resolution
entries.semantic_contract: Verify required plans, contracts, sources and upstream packet/gate states.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Missing prerequisite cannot be manufactured from design prose.

entries.name: Contract build
entries.semantic_contract: Materialise declared contracts without inventing semantics.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Contract construction is not semantic or scientific promotion.

entries.name: Schema build
entries.semantic_contract: Create typed schemas and deterministic validation from frozen contracts.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Schema validity does not prove model validity or authority.

entries.name: Fixture build
entries.semantic_contract: Build golden, synthetic, adversarial and boundary fixtures.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Synthetic fixtures are not market evidence.

entries.name: Deterministic implementation
entries.semantic_contract: Implement frozen deterministic behaviour and conformance.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Implementation PASS cannot change frozen semantics.

entries.name: Git packet management
entries.semantic_contract: Branch, commit, push, PR and eligible integration mechanics as separately permitted.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Tool reachability or branch capability does not grant merge authority.

entries.name: Test planning
entries.semantic_contract: Plan impact-aware packet, dependency and integration assurance.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Test planning cannot narrow uncertain impact to evade assurance.

entries.name: Test execution
entries.semantic_contract: Execute a frozen test plan and emit reproducible receipts.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Test success cannot waive required QA or gates.

entries.name: QA evaluation
entries.semantic_contract: Evaluate named QA assertions from evidence.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: QA may not create semantics or reserved authority.

entries.name: Evidence audit
entries.semantic_contract: Audit hashes, manifests, provenance, reproducibility and staleness.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Evidence audit may flag but not rewrite source records.

entries.name: Gate evaluation
entries.semantic_contract: Evaluate acceptance conditions and classify proposed authority delta.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Operator-reserved gates cannot be auto-approved by capability output.

entries.name: Packet execution
entries.semantic_contract: Sequence one complete packet lifecycle under frozen current authority.
entries.prohibited_interpretation: Orchestration executes plans; it does not author or enlarge them.
